name: hsi-structured-evidence-v1
description: Curated draft fixture from the openly available DAUHST arXiv LaTeX source. It is a paper-level smoke fixture, not a production domain gold set.

cases.annotation_note: A maintainer checked the Results and Experimental Settings sections in the cited source. A second independent annotation pass and additional papers are still required before release scoring.
condition_evidence_quotes: Following the settings of TSA-Net, HDNet, GAP-Net, GSM, and MST, the CAVE dataset is adopted as the training set while 10 scenes from the KAIST dataset are selected for testing.
Patches with spatial sizes 256x256 and 660x660 are randomly cropped from the 3D HSI cubes with 28 channels as training samples for the simulation and real experiments.

quantities.evidence_quote: Our best model DAUHST-9stg (9-stage DAUHST) yields very impressive results, i.e., 38.36 dB in PSNR and 0.967 in SSIM.
